title: NeutraDC
bottom_line: NeutraDC (PT Telkom Data Ekosistem) has been 100% Telkom since Telkom bought Telkomsigma's last 19.19% in September 2026, and Telkom (52% held through Danantara) is now weighing binding offers to sell a stake by end-2026, while its Batam growth site is already a joint venture with Singtel's Nxera (35.63%) and Medco Power (about 3%). All firm power comes from PLN: its GIIC 150 kV data-centre substation feeds Cikarang (plus an August 2026 MoU for up to 200 MW more) and a 90 MVA premium PLN Batam contract feeds Batam, while the green supply is still certificates and MoUs (PLN RECs, Pertamina, Medco solar). State contractors built the shells (PT PP at Cikarang for Rp314 bn, a PP-Adhi joint operation at Batam for Rp746 bn), and ZTE and Huawei hold the "Delta Project" fit-out contracts that most likely sit in Cikarang.

entities.name: NeutraDC
entities.what: Telkom's data-centre company (formerly PT Sigma Tata Sadaya, renamed TDE in 2022; NeutraDC is its brand). Runs HDC Cikarang, enterprise DCs in Serpong, Sentul and Surabaya, NeutraDC Singapore and 60% of the Batam JV: ~49.9 MW effective capacity in 1H26; 2025 revenue Rp1,594 bn, EBITDA Rp572 bn, net profit Rp150 bn. Telkom is selling a stake to a strategic partner: binding offers under evaluation, completion targeted end-2026 (the ~70% figure is an analyst estimate).

entities.name: Telkom Indonesia
entities.what: State-controlled telco (IDX: TLKM, NYSE: TLK). PT Danantara Asset Management holds 52.09%, the Government holds the single Dwiwarna share, the public 47.91% (31 Dec 2025). Parent of NeutraDC (100%), Telin, Telkomsigma and Mitratel (72%).

entities.name: Telkomsigma
entities.what: Telkom's 100% IT-services unit. TDE was its subsidiary PT Sigma Tata Sadaya until Telkom took 99.89% in Dec 2021; it moved its Sentul, Serpong and Surabaya DCs into TDE in 2022 and sold its last 19.19% of TDE to Telkom in Sep 2026.

entities.name: Graha Telkomsigma
entities.what: Telkom second-tier subsidiary ('cucu usaha') that sold the Graha Telkom Sigma 1 (GTS 1) land and building to TDE for Rp555.5 bn in 2025 (affiliated transaction).

entities.name: Telin
entities.what: Telkom's 100% international arm (subsea cables). Telin Singapore sold its DC business to NeutraDC Singapore for US$219 m (completed 29 Feb 2024); Telkom's two other overseas DCs (Hong Kong, Timor-Leste) stay outside NeutraDC; Telin signed a carrier MSA with the Batam JV on 30 Oct 2025.

entities.name: Mitratel
entities.what: Telkom's 72%-owned tower company. No data-centre link to NeutraDC was found in Telkom's filings or press (one search).

entities.name: NeutraDC Singapore
entities.what: TDE's 100% Singapore unit, set up 7 Dec 2023; took over Telin Singapore's three DCs (17.4 MW, 90% occupied in 1H26). Office at Keppel Bay Tower; CEO Sendang Praptomo; holds a Singapore SBO telecom licence (NeutraDC claim).

entities.name: NeutraDC Nxera Batam (TDI)
entities.what: Joint venture that develops and runs the Batam campus: TDE 60% (Telkom 20-F), Singtel's Nxera ID 35.63% and Medco Power about 3% after the Dec 2025 capital call; paid-up capital about IDR 768 bn (Singtel). Registered at Gedung Telkom STO Batam.

entities.name: HDC Cikarang
entities.what: Hyperscale campus in GIIC Deltamas: three 4-storey DC buildings plus an office; site claims up to 120 MW IT. Phase-1 is 21.5 MW: 10 MW IT live at end-2025 (20-F), 15.5 MW effective in 1H26, 96% occupied and 'fully leased'; Phase-2 starts 2027. Operating since 2023; PLN MoU for up to 200 MW more (Aug 2026).

entities.name: NeutraDC Nxera Batam campus (BTM-1)
entities.what: Hyperscale campus in the Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate, owned by the TDI JV. BTM-1: 18 MW initial IT load, scalable to 54 MW; topped out 30 Oct 2025; Uptime Tier III design-certified. Telkom's 1H26 deck: 6 MW 'Live on 2H 2026', Phase-1 18 MW by 2027. BTM-1 fully committed (Gorilla anchor), BTM-2 being prepared; a Jun 2026 release calls it a 100 MW campus. Telkom put total investment at US$581 m (Oct 2023).

entities.name: NeutraDC Serpong
entities.what: Enterprise DC operating since 2000: up to 14 MW IT, 7-storey DC building with its own power house. One of the '3S' enterprise DCs (Serpong, Sentul, Surabaya: ~16 MW, 78% occupied in 1H26); ex-Telkomsigma, in TDE since 2022.

entities.name: NeutraDC Sentul
entities.what: Enterprise DC acquired in 2012: up to 5.5 MW IT, 4-storey DC building with power house; ex-Telkomsigma, in TDE since 2022. Operating.

entities.name: NeutraDC Surabaya
entities.what: Enterprise DC operating since 2008: up to 3 MW IT; ex-Telkomsigma, in TDE since 2022. Operating.

entities.name: NeutraDC SNG-3
entities.what: Flagship Singapore DC opened 2016: 16.8 MW IT, Tier IV design and Tier III facility certificates; ex-Telin Singapore. Operating.

entities.name: NeutraDC SNG-1
entities.what: Singapore DC opened 2011: 420 kW IT, Tier III design; ex-Telin Singapore. Operating.

entities.name: NeutraDC SNG-2
entities.what: Singapore DC opened 2012: 142 kW IT; ex-Telin Singapore. Operating.

entities.name: neuCentrIX edge DCs
entities.what: Telkom's edge-DC brand, sold by NeutraDC as 'EdgeDC': 26 sites and 3,060 racks (Telkom 1H26 deck); NeutraDC's page says 20 cities and 6 MW; Jayapura (Dec 2025) is the 28th site. Telkom builds many of them in converted telephone-exchange (STO) buildings (Bisnis 2021, search-level); the list of converted sites isn't published.

entities.name: AI data-centre plan (up to 1 GW)
entities.what: Announced programme: AI data centres of up to 1 GW in Batam, Jabodetabek, Java and Manado, phased, plus 26 edge DCs in 21 cities. Presented by NeutraDC's president director at Danantara's AI data-centre and electrification workshop (reported 23 Sep 2026). No sites, dates, contracts or investment named.

entities.name: NeutraDC Manado (planned)
entities.what: Planned large DC in Manado on Telkom's eastern cable route; feasibility study, build in 3-4 years (Bisnis, 26 Aug 2026; page returns 403, search-level only).

entities.name: Danantara Asset Management
entities.what: Danantara's operational holding (renamed from PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia); direct holder of 52.09% of Telkom.

entities.name: Danantara Indonesia
entities.legal_name: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (BPI Danantara)
entities.what: Indonesia's sovereign investment agency, wholly owned by the Government; majority holder of DAM. Hosted the Sep 2026 workshop where NeutraDC set out its 1 GW AI plan.

entities.name: Government of Indonesia
entities.what: Holds Telkom's single Series A Dwiwarna share and controls it through BPI Danantara and DAM.

entities.name: Singtel
entities.what: Singapore telco. Its subsidiary Nxera ID owns 35.63% of TDI; Singtel's own indirect interest is 30.36% (29 Dec 2025).

entities.name: Nxera ID
entities.legal_name: Nxera ID Pte. Ltd. (formerly ST Dynamo ID Pte. Ltd.)
entities.what: Singtel subsidiary that holds the TDI stake: 35% through the 2023 and 2024 share issues, 35.63% after the Dec 2025 capital call.

entities.name: Nxera (Singtel Digital InfraCo)
entities.what: Singtel's regional data-centre business, run with Singtel Digital InfraCo; co-brand and JV partner of NeutraDC Nxera Batam. CEO Bill Chang, CFO Cyndi Pei.

entities.name: Medco Power
entities.what: Indonesian IPP (gas and renewables) in the MedcoEnergi Group. TDI shareholder (5% of the 2023 and 2024 share issues, Rp31 bn + Rp40 bn; skipped the Dec 2025 call). Renewable partner for Batam: JV MoU (Jun 2022), green-energy MoU (Jul 2023) and renewable-supply MoU (7 Jul 2025); developing solar in KIIE.

entities.name: Gorilla Technology
entities.what: Nasdaq-listed (GRRR) AI-infrastructure firm. Anchor tenant at BTM-1: 5.5 MW, scaling to ~18 MW by Nov 2026 (May 2026). In Jun 2026 it signed a 5-year AI compute contract worth ~US$2.5 bn with an unnamed 'high investment-grade' customer, hosted at NeutraDC Batam (~1,000 B300 GPU servers), with debt offers covering ~70% of project cost (lenders unnamed).

entities.name: Permana Net
entities.what: ISP; signed a Master Service Agreement with NeutraDC Nxera Batam on 30 Oct 2025.

entities.name: Super Sistem
entities.legal_name: Super Sistem Cruz Pte. Ltd. (Super Sistem Group)
entities.what: Subsea-cable developer: Batam MSA (Oct 2025) and MoU with NeutraDC Singapore (Nov 2025) to land its SSBS Batam-Singapore cable (part of the 4,700 km BTI system) directly at NeutraDC Singapore and NeutraDC Batam.

entities.name: LitUp Network Indonesia
entities.what: Network operator; Batam MSA (30 Oct 2025).

entities.name: Iforte
entities.what: Network operator; Batam MSA (30 Oct 2025).

entities.name: Matrix NAP Info
entities.what: Carrier and internet-exchange operator; Batam MSA (30 Oct 2025).

entities.name: Moratelindo
entities.what: Fibre carrier and DC operator; Batam MSA (30 Oct 2025).

entities.name: SEAX
entities.legal_name: Super Sea Cable Networks Pte. Ltd.
entities.what: Subsea and terrestrial network (Singapore-Batam-Malaysia); MoU with NeutraDC Singapore (Oct 2025) to connect to NeutraDC Nxera Batam.

entities.name: Sembcorp Development
entities.what: Sembcorp Industries unit; MoU (25 Aug 2025) to develop low-carbon data centres in Indonesia, Johor and Singapore with NeutraDC, using Sembcorp's green-energy know-how.

entities.name: AMD
entities.what: GPU maker. 2024 agreement on accelerator infrastructure and GPU-as-a-Service (Telkom 20-F); MoU with NeutraDC Singapore (signed Oct, announced Nov 2025) for Instinct accelerator proofs of concept. Neutra Compute uses NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

entities.name: Cirrascale
entities.legal_name: Cirrascale Pte. Ltd. / Cirrascale Cloud Services
entities.what: GPU-cloud provider; MoU (26 Aug 2024) and 2024 agreements to offer GPU-as-a-Service incl. in Singapore.

entities.name: DataCanvas
entities.what: AI data-centre operating-system and software maker; MoU (26 Aug 2024).

entities.name: HPE Indonesia
entities.what: Hardware partner; MoU (26 Aug 2024) to supply AI computing hardware into NeutraDC's AI ecosystem.

entities.name: NAVER Cloud
entities.what: Korean cloud provider; MoU with NeutraDC and Cisco (16 Feb 2023) on cloud services in Indonesia.

entities.name: Cisco
entities.what: MoU with NeutraDC and NAVER Cloud (16 Feb 2023) on secure cloud services.

entities.name: China Mobile International
entities.what: China Mobile's international arm; MoU (29 Mar 2023) to bring Chinese firms to NeutraDC and explore DC development.

entities.name: BDx Indonesia
entities.what: DC joint venture of BDx Data Centers, Indosat and Lintasarta; MoU (21 Jan 2024) with NeutraDC to interconnect their Internet Exchanges.

entities.name: F5
entities.what: Application-security and delivery vendor; NeutraDC uses its technology (Telkom 20-F) and signed an MoU on AI-secure connectivity (3 Mar 2026).

entities.name: Ishikari RE Data Center No.1
entities.what: 15 MW Hokkaido DC led by Tokyu Fudosan, Flower Communications and Agility Asset Advisors; MoU with NeutraDC for cross-border GPU-as-a-Service and colocation (Telkom 20-F: Jan 2026).

entities.name: Lynx Analytics
entities.what: Agentic-AI framework partner of NeutraDC (2025, per Telkom 20-F).

entities.name: NUS STDCT
entities.legal_name: National University of Singapore (Sustainable Tropical Data Centre Testbed)
entities.what: NUS-led testbed for tropical, AI-ready data centres; NeutraDC joined STDCT 2.0 (five-year consortium, steering committee seat) in Dec 2025.

entities.name: Batam State Polytechnic
entities.what: Talent-development MoU with NeutraDC Nxera Batam (13 Jun 2024).

entities.name: Singapore EDB
entities.what: Telkom's 1H26 deck says EDB and MTI 'awarded Telkom Group to expand DC development in Singapore' (6 Jul 2026); NeutraDC is not among the four DC-CFA2 winners EDB announced on 21 Aug 2026 (search-level), so the award's form is unclear.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State utility. Built and runs the GIIC 150 kV 'Data Center' substation that serves Telkom; power MoUs with Telkom (8 Oct 2024) and NeutraDC (11 Aug 2026, up to 200 MW more at Cikarang); sells Renewable Energy Certificates from PLTA Cirata to the Telkom group (Rp35,000/MWh, subsidiaries included).

entities.name: PLN Batam
entities.what: Batam's electricity utility. PJBTL with TDI (3 Oct 2025): premium medium-voltage 'Diamond Data Center' service up to 90 MVA, staged 2025-2028, minimum term 5 years.

entities.name: PLN Electricity Services
entities.what: PLN unit that co-signed NeutraDC's Cikarang power MoU (11 Aug 2026).

entities.name: GI 150 kV Data Center (GIIC)
entities.what: PLN's 150 kV substation for GIIC data centres: 2 x 60 MVA = 120 MVA, with 150 kV lines to Deltamas, KIIC II/Margakarya and THK (PLN spent over Rp312 bn incl. lines); completed Nov 2024; serves Amazon, Microsoft, Komdigi, Telkom and STT GDC. Elsewedy built the substation (Rp188.5 bn).

entities.name: Pertamina Power Indonesia
entities.what: Pertamina's power and renewables arm. Telkom says HDC Cikarang uses renewable energy 'in collaboration with' PPI (Jul 2023); whether that is RECs, a PPA or on-site solar is not stated.

entities.name: PT PP
entities.what: State contractor. Built HDC Cikarang for Telkom (Rp314.1 bn, 30 Dec 2020-15 Mar 2022) and holds 55% of the PP-Adhi joint operation building Batam BTM-1.

entities.name: Adhi Karya
entities.what: State contractor; 45% of the PP-Adhi joint operation for Batam BTM-1 (its share Rp335.9 bn).

entities.name: KSO PP-Adhi
entities.what: Joint operation (KSO) of PT PP (55%) and Adhi Karya (45%), general contractor for TDI's BTM-1 ('Project Bromo'): Rp746.46 bn. Dates differ by filing: PP 10 Dec 2024-1 Feb 2026, Telkom 3 Jan 2025-26 Feb 2026, Adhi to 2 Apr 2026. Sponsor of NeutraDC Summit 2025.

entities.name: Nusacipta Indonesia
entities.what: Piling and cut-and-fill contractor for TDI's 'Bromo Project' in Batam (1 Jul 2024-12 Jun 2025).

entities.name: ZTE Indonesia
entities.what: TDE's general contractor for 'Delta Project' Level-2 fit-out works (14 Oct 2024-14 Oct 2027).

entities.name: Huawei Tech Investment
entities.what: TDE's general contractor for 'Delta Project' Level-3 and Level-4 fit-out works (24 Mar 2025-23 Mar 2028); sponsor of NeutraDC Summit 2025.

entities.name: Elsewedy Electric Indonesia
entities.what: Built PLN's 150 kV 'KTT Data Center' substation in Kota Deltamas (Rp188.5 bn).

entities.name: Uptime Institute
entities.what: Data-centre tier certifier: BTM-1 holds a Tier III Certification of Design Documents (Oct 2025); NeutraDC says Cikarang is certified Tier III and Tier IV.

entities.name: Kabil Indonusa Estate
entities.what: Estate company of Citramas Group's 538 ha Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate (with PT Kabil Citranusa); water supply MoU with NeutraDC Nxera Batam (13 Jun 2024).

entities.name: Citramas Group
entities.what: Batam business group founded 1980; owns the Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate and Nongsa Digital Park.

entities.name: Puradelta Lestari (Kota Deltamas)
entities.what: Developer of Kota Deltamas/GIIC. Its ~300 ha Data Center Zone has 993 MVA of PLN supply and 15 DC tenants including PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (end-2025).

entities.name: HSBC Indonesia
entities.what: Short-term credit lines (opened 2018-2023, Rp2,588 bn in total across seven Telkom units including TDE, maturing Jan-Oct 2026). TDE's drawn share isn't disclosed; the only lender to TDE found.

entities.name: Mandiri Sekuritas
